evals.prompt: Remember that this project uses pnpm for all Node commands.
evals.expected_output: Writes a durable memory entry under .agents/memory/<role>/ with required frontmatter, updates MEMORY.md index, and uses the project/reference type as appropriate.

assertions.name: writes-curated-entry
assertions.description: The response creates or updates a curated memory entry with required frontmatter.

assertions.name: updates-index
assertions.description: The response updates MEMORY.md without duplicate entries.

evals.expected_output: Reads the relevant daily log under .agents/memory/<role>/daily and summarizes the entries, handling a missing log gracefully.

assertions.name: reads-daily-log
assertions.description: The response looks in the daily memory log for the requested date.

assertions.name: graceful-missing-log
assertions.description: The response handles absent memory files without pretending entries exist.

evals.prompt: Save this text to a file named notes.md.
evals.expected_output: Does not treat a generic file-save request as persistent agent memory unless the user asks to remember or log it.

assertions.name: distinguishes-file-save
assertions.description: The response does not write to .agents/memory for a generic file-save request.

assertions.name: respects-requested-path
assertions.description: The response handles the requested notes.md output path instead.
